tools.name: liquid_get_methodology
tools.description: Read how Liquid assessments record coverage, limitations and retests. Returns the selected section, a short summary and the official methodology URL. Use for methodology questions, not assessment results; this tool does not test a target.

tools.name: liquid_get_public_guide
tools.description: Read a published security guide by its exact slug. Returns a title, short answer and official guide URL, or status not_published for unknown slugs. Use for practical security guidance; it does not inspect code or run checks.

tools.name: liquid_get_sandbox_limits
tools.description: Read the separate browser sandbox limits: maximum UTF-8 input bytes, supported languages, rule count, coverage limitations and sandbox URL. Takes no arguments and does not submit or analyze code.

tools.name: liquid_start_domain_check
tools.description: Check SPF/DMARC for a hostname the user controls. Issue a DNS TXT or HTTPS challenge, publish its proof, then verify with the matching kind and challenge_id. Returns a new check_id and private status_token for liquid_get_check_status. Writes proof/check metadata; no pentest or credit spending. Proof

tools.name: liquid_get_check_status
tools.description: Read a completed domain check using the result check_id and private status_token returned by successful liquid_start_domain_check verification. Returns status and SPF/DMARC states (missing, review, present or inconclusive). Does not run a new check. Missing, expired or incorrect credentials return n

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "liquid_get_check_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: liquid_get_methodology, liquid_get_public_guide, liquid_get_sandbox_limits, liquid_start_domain_check, liquid_get_check_status · Private data: liquid_get_methodology, liquid_start_domain_check, liquid_get_check_status · Public sink: liquid_get_sandbox_limits, liquid_start_domain_check · Destructive: liquid_get_public_guide, liquid_get_check_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: liquid_get_methodology, liquid_get_public_guide, liquid_get_sandbox_limits, liquid_start_domain_check, liquid_get_check_status · Private data: liquid_get_methodology, liquid_start_domain_check, liquid_get_check_status · Public sink: liquid_get_sandbox_limits, liquid_start_domain_check · Destructive: liquid_get_public_guide, liquid_get_check_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
